Summary: Checks the Hosted SPF (PowerSPF) record of every domain in PowerDMARC: at most 10 DNS lookups and 2 void lookups, no errors, and an -all or ~all ending. Checks that every email domain of the Microsoft 365 tenant is onboarded in PowerDMARC, and lists PowerDMARC domains the tenant does not have. One result per domain, grouped by customer account for resellers. Reads only; changes nothing.

Prerequisites.Text: A PowerDMARC Personal Access Token (API Settings > Personal Access Tokens), or for resellers an MSSP token (API Settings > Manage API Tokens).
Maester installs the PowerDMARC module 0.1.1 from the PowerShell Gallery with the pack.
For MP.WEY.POWERDMARC.1002: a Microsoft Graph connection that can read the tenant's domains (Domain.Read.All; the default Connect-Maester scopes include Directory.Read.All, which covers it).

Steps.Text: End user: the domains of the token's own account.
Reseller (MSSP): every customer account on your portal, or one with AccountId.
Steps.Command: Connect-Maester -Service WEY.POWERDMARC.Api -ServiceSetting @{ ApiToken = (Read-Host -AsSecureString 'PowerDMARC token'); Mode = 'Reseller'; BaseUri = 'reseller.powerdmarc.com' }

Steps.Text: With Microsoft Graph too, to compare the tenant's domains with PowerDMARC (MP.WEY.POWERDMARC.1002).
Steps.Command: Connect-Maester -Service Graph, WEY.POWERDMARC.Api -ServiceSetting @{ ApiToken = (Read-Host -AsSecureString 'PowerDMARC token'); Mode = 'Reseller'; BaseUri = 'reseller.powerdmarc.com' }

Commands.Text: Run the pack on its own.

Options.Name: MaximumLookups
Options.Text: The most DNS lookups the SPF record may need (1 to 10).

Options.Name: MaximumVoidLookups
Options.Text: The most lookups that may return nothing.

Options.Name: RequireHardFail
Options.Text: Accept only -all; by default ~all passes too.

Options.Name: WEY.POWERDMARC.TenantAccountId
Options.Text: GlobalSettings, Reseller mode: the customer account that holds this tenant's domains (MP.WEY.POWERDMARC.1002). 0 uses the connection's AccountId, else every account.

Options.Name: WEY.POWERDMARC.IncludeInitialDomains
Options.Text: GlobalSettings: MP.WEY.POWERDMARC.1002 also checks the *.onmicrosoft.com domains.

AppOnly.Text: Runs unattended with the token in the MAESTER_WEY_POWERDMARC_API_APITOKEN environment variable (and _MODE, _BASEURI, _ACCOUNTID as needed). MP.WEY.POWERDMARC.1001 needs no Microsoft sign-in; MP.WEY.POWERDMARC.1002 needs an app connection to Microsoft Graph with the application permission Domain.Read.All.
